names.legendary: Sir Spherion, Lord of the Last Bounce

lore.common: Finds the only drain in a football field. Nobody has ever taught it how.
lore.uncommon: Vanished into the neighbour's hedge in 1998. Still sends postcards from behind the leaves.
lore.rare: Has an unerring instinct for expensive vases, particularly ones labelled irreplaceable.
lore.epic: Bounced through the stadium, bank, museum and mayor's office without touching the ground. The town has banned geometry.
lore.legendary: The first ball ever kicked has never landed. Spherion still circles the heavens, occasionally returning a lost penalty to its rightful owner.

names.legendary: Zingorius, Master of the Eternal Rebound

lore.common: Bounces directly into the nearest ceiling light. The light has submitted its resignation.
lore.uncommon: Disappears beneath the fridge and makes a new life among dust bunnies.
lore.rare: Gains height with every bounce. The child who dropped it on Tuesday is still tracking it with a telescope.
lore.epic: Ricocheted through every room in the house and arranged all the fridge magnets into alphabetical order by accident.
lore.legendary: Zingorius was dropped from the highest tower and returned higher than it began. Legends say gravity now crosses the street to avoid him.

names.legendary: Octavia, the Oracle Who Says Maybe

lore.common: Answers every urgent question with 'ask again later'. Considers this excellent customer service.
lore.uncommon: Floats its little blue triangle just out of sight until someone shakes it like a maraca.
lore.rare: Knows the answer before you ask, but replaces 'yes' with 'absolutely not' whenever it feels bored.
lore.epic: Predicted rain at the school fair, then spent all afternoon refusing to explain why frogs were falling from the sky.
lore.legendary: Octavia once answered a question the stars were afraid to ask. Her answer was 'concentrate and ask again', and the constellations have been rearranging themselves ever since.

names.legendary: Rollox, the Marble That Found Tomorrow

lore.common: Rattles over the bedroom floor just after everyone has fallen asleep.
lore.uncommon: Hides beneath the skirting board and clicks smugly whenever someone looks for it.
lore.rare: Rolls uphill, curves around corners and returns to the hand that tried to put it away.
lore.epic: Escaped the school marble tournament and ricocheted through every classroom, triggering a chain reaction of falling chairs and flying chalk.
lore.legendary: Rollox was flicked around the world once and returned a heartbeat before it left. The swirls within its glass now show every place it will ever roll.

names.legendary: Tranquilax, Eater of Mondays

lore.common: Lives on a desk and pulls increasingly dramatic faces during meetings.
lore.uncommon: Grows a tiny frown whenever someone opens their inbox. It has many frowns.
lore.rare: Feeds on nervous thoughts and releases them as apologetic squeaks under the table.
lore.epic: Swallowed the panic of a hundred accountants at year-end and expanded into a soft fortress around the office.
lore.legendary: Tranquilax once absorbed a kingdom's fear before a siege, leaving its defenders serenely knitting on the battlements. The invaders were deeply unsettled.

names.legendary: Balthazar, Baron of the Upper Air

lore.common: Floats just beyond a child's fingertips. It considers this a highly sophisticated practical joke.
lore.uncommon: Only pops during solemn speeches. Wedding organisers have started checking guest lists for latex.
lore.rare: Rubbed itself against a jumper and stole every hairdo in the room. The portraits have not forgiven it.
lore.epic: Lifted an entire shopping trolley over the supermarket. The manager called it the first successful express checkout.
lore.legendary: Carried the first birthday wish into the stars and returned a century later with a cake recipe written in constellations.

names.legendary: Festivora, the Neverending Finale

lore.common: Appears in your socks six months after the wedding. Refuses to explain how.
lore.uncommon: Sneaks into the vacuum cleaner and throws a private party inside.
lore.rare: Every piece you sweep up becomes two. Mathematicians advise leaving the house.
lore.epic: Showered a royal coronation in so much glitter that the palace was mistaken for a disco ball from space.
lore.legendary: The first celebration ended, but Festivora never stopped falling. Its coloured fragments still drift through forgotten birthdays, reunions and the king's tax audits.

names.legendary: Babe Ruthless, the Skybreaker

lore.common: Swings grandly at empty air and demands applause for its technique.
lore.uncommon: Leaves splinters in every hand except the one holding a winning ticket.
lore.rare: Makes every ball it hits buzz angrily like a hornet. Fielders have started carrying nets.
lore.epic: Launched a home run across three counties, through a wedding and into a weather balloon. The umpire is still travelling to measure it.
lore.legendary: Legends claim its final swing sent a baseball into orbit. Every shooting star is merely the ball returning for another inning.

names.legendary: Hoopra, Sovereign of the Perfect Swish

lore.common: Rolls around the rim for ten seconds before deciding the audience looks too happy.
lore.uncommon: Bounces down the hallway at midnight, playing a solo concert for the downstairs neighbours.
lore.rare: Ducks away from the hoop whenever someone says WATCH THIS. Never misses when nobody is looking.
lore.epic: Dunked through the school gym floor and emerged from the kitchen with a custard crown. The referee counted it.
lore.legendary: Has never touched a rim in a thousand years. The ball simply chooses where the hoop should be, and reality adjusts.

names.legendary: Chromadoodle, Lord of Unfinished Worlds

lore.common: Colours outside its own lines, then claims the lines moved first.
lore.uncommon: Hides the one crayon needed to finish a picture. It always chooses blue.
lore.rare: Makes its drawings move whenever nobody is looking. Yesterday the sheep escaped its page.
lore.epic: Turned an entire school into a giant colouring page. The children painted the headteacher purple and the building looked significantly better.
lore.legendary: Chromadoodle gives life to every drawing left unfinished. Its castle contains half-coloured dragons, upside-down rainbows and a terrifyingly ambitious stick figure.

names.legendary: Lacturion, Chalice of Lullabies

lore.common: Leaks a single drop of milk onto every clean outfit. Claims it is signing its work.
lore.uncommon: Rolls under the sofa right when feeding time begins. Nobody has ever caught it moving.
lore.rare: Keeps milk at the perfect temperature through enchanted glass. Unfortunately it screams BEEP when the baby finally falls asleep.
lore.epic: Launched a jet of milk across the nursery and accidentally painted a perfect portrait on the ceiling. The baby gave it a standing ovation from the high chair.
lore.legendary: Lacturion carries the warm milk of the first dawn. One sip can hush a nursery full of sleepless infants; the adults are still trying to convince it to work on them too.

names.legendary: Guzzlor, Keeper of the Final Drop

lore.common: Aims water at the nose instead of the mouth, even during important matches.
lore.uncommon: Lets everyone chew its spout until it resembles a tiny rubber hedgehog.
lore.rare: Refills itself whenever its owner starts to tire, but the water tastes suspiciously of oranges and victory.
lore.epic: Squeezed a fountain over the entire football pitch at half-time, sending players sailing over the grass like surfers.
lore.legendary: Guzzlor carried one last drop of water across the Great Dry Marathon. It gave the drop to the runner in last place, who finished first with a grateful grin.

names.legendary: Chromalith, Keeper of the Unnamed Hue

lore.common: Eats the blue crayon just before the ocean picture begins.
lore.uncommon: Hides the skin-coloured crayon and hands everyone purple instead.
lore.rare: Swaps every crayon's wrapper. Children's pictures become brilliant, baffling masterpieces.
lore.epic: Unleashed forty-eight colours that escaped the page and repainted the entire school. The headmaster is still turquoise.
lore.legendary: Contains a colour that has never existed in nature. Only children can see it, and every adult who tries insists the sun has always been plaid.

names.legendary: Jackclock, Lord of the Thirteenth Chime

lore.common: Pops up just as someone takes a sip of tea. The carpet has learned to duck.
lore.uncommon: Winds its own handle when nobody is listening and starts the tune at bedtime.
lore.rare: Refuses to spring until everyone has relaxed, then erupts at the precise worst moment.
lore.epic: Launched itself through the birthday party ceiling and reappeared wearing the chandelier. The magician refused to compete.
lore.legendary: Jackclock was sealed inside a clock tower by a king who feared surprises. Each midnight it leaps from the highest window to remind the whole kingdom that wonder cannot be locked away.

names.legendary: Pirouetta, the Dancer Who Left the Lid

lore.common: Wobbles its tiny ballerina around in circles until someone remembers to wind the key again.
lore.uncommon: Spins whenever the lid opens, even if its audience is a single sleepy teddy bear.
lore.rare: Steps off its little platform after dark to practise new dances among the toy soldiers.
lore.epic: Escaped the jewellery box during a wedding and led all the table decorations in a grand waltz. Nobody noticed until the flowers demanded applause.
lore.legendary: Pirouetta danced free of her clockwork stage at the stroke of midnight and taught the statues of the royal garden to move. At sunrise, every stone figure held a different pose.

names.legendary: Bucketina, Queen of the Sandcastle

lore.common: Makes a perfect sandcastle shape and tips it over the moment the photographer arrives.
lore.uncommon: Keeps one tiny crab inside, who now insists on being called the castle's royal guard.
lore.rare: Builds a sand turret that withstands three waves and a very determined toddler.
lore.epic: Built a beach fortress so vast that the lifeguards needed a map to patrol it. The tide demanded a visitor's pass.
lore.legendary: Bucketina once raised a castle of wet sand from a beach before sunrise. At high tide the towers rose with the water, and for a single night the crabs ruled a floating kingdom.

names.legendary: Galeflora, Spinner of the Four Winds

lore.common: Only spins when its owner runs fast enough to get out of breath.
lore.uncommon: Turns in the wrong direction just to make the wind look confused.
lore.rare: Blows out birthday candles from across the room, stealing every child's wish.
lore.epic: Rode a gale over the seaside fair, scattering its rainbow colours across the sky. The lighthouse spent the evening glowing pink.
lore.legendary: Galeflora spun atop the first hill when the four winds could not agree where to blow. The weather has followed her bright blades ever since.

names.legendary: Padalord, the Secret Button King

lore.common: Complains by vibrating whenever its buttons are mashed too hard. The player calls it feedback.
lore.uncommon: Nudges the joystick left whenever someone is walking past an important ledge.
lore.rare: Can press a secret combination while its owner sleeps. The television has begun offering congratulations.
lore.epic: Rumbled so violently at the gaming finals that the whole row of spectators vibrated into the snack bar.
lore.legendary: Padalord knows the impossible button combination that unlocks a hidden door in every game. Nobody has tried it because it requires seventeen thumbs.

names.legendary: Pocketmax, Master of the Final Screen

lore.common: Dies one button press before the last boss falls. Its owner has developed trust issues.
lore.uncommon: Has a cracked corner and considers it a badge of honour from the Great Sofa Drop.
lore.rare: Can pause everything around its player except the ticking clock. The homework has been waiting since Tuesday.
lore.epic: Opened a secret level on the train and turned every window into a different game world. The conductor asked for a controller.
lore.legendary: Pocketmax holds a game no developer remembers making. Every player who finishes it finds their name carved into a stone beside the original start screen.

names.legendary: Sir Soakwell, Champion of the Final Set

lore.common: Steals every drop of sweat except the one running directly into your eye.
lore.uncommon: Squeezes itself out whenever the coach reaches for a handshake.
lore.rare: Absorbs the nerves of a whole tennis team and drips them onto the opponent's shoes.
lore.epic: Soaked up an entire stadium's summer heat and wrung out an indoor rainstorm over the referee's chair.
lore.legendary: Sir Soakwell guarded the brow of a champion through a match that lasted seven suns. The final drop fell only after the winning point.

names.legendary: Perrukana, the Hundred-Faced Queen

lore.common: Slips sideways whenever its wearer attempts to look serious.
lore.uncommon: Itches so much that a pirate costume becomes a frantic dance.
lore.rare: Gives its wearer a different personality with every new hairstyle.
lore.epic: Swapped every wig at the royal masquerade. The king ended up dressed as a washerwoman and demanded better wages.
lore.legendary: Has worn a hundred faces throughout history, standing beside rulers, artists and thieves. Only its hairdresser knows which stories are true.

names.legendary: Infinata, Guardian of the Last Sweet

lore.common: Ducks every stick and makes a very rude paper-mache face at the birthday child.
lore.uncommon: Pretends to be full of sweets but hides one rubber chicken among the treats.
lore.rare: Refills itself overnight with whatever the children least expect. Last week it was tiny cabbages.
lore.epic: Refused to break at a hundred birthday parties. When it finally cracked, sweets rained across three neighbourhoods and the dentists declared a holiday.
lore.legendary: Infinata holds a single sweet that tastes like the happiest birthday you ever had. Even ancient dragons queue once a year to try it, wearing extremely silly paper hats.

names.legendary: Rockalump, the Unstoppable Throne

lore.common: Squeaks whenever a grown-up tries to have a serious conversation.
lore.uncommon: Sways so dramatically that the dog keeps attempting to rescue its rider.
lore.rare: Shuffles across the nursery one rock at a time. The biscuit cupboard is now permanently guarded.
lore.epic: Rocked the playroom so hard that every toy began moving in rhythm. The teddy bears filed a complaint about motion sickness.
lore.legendary: Rockalump rocked for a hundred years without advancing an inch, then finally rolled forward and crossed the kingdom before anybody could say bedtime.

names.legendary: Nocturno, Keeper of Borrowed Faces

lore.common: Slides sideways until the eyeholes end up somewhere near the wearer's ears.
lore.uncommon: Makes the smallest child sound like a very stern monster demanding biscuits.
lore.rare: Borrows any face at the costume party and returns it with a mischievous expression.
lore.epic: Slipped onto the mayor at the festival and turned him into a roaring tiger. His speech was short but extremely memorable.
lore.legendary: Nocturno has worn the faces of a hundred forgotten kings. Beneath them is a single smile that has never belonged to anyone alive.

names.legendary: Sculptoria, Mother of All Make-Believe

lore.common: Gets pressed into the carpet and declares itself part of the interior decoration.
lore.uncommon: Mixes every bright colour into one stubborn brown lump, then calls it modern art.
lore.rare: Comes alive as the shape it wore at bedtime. The tiny dough dinosaur has eaten three imaginary sandwiches.
lore.epic: Rose as a gigantic sculpture in the classroom and chased the teachers through a maze of coloured clay. The children demanded an extra art lesson.
lore.legendary: Sculptoria shaped the first imaginary creature from a child's handful of dough. Every strange beast dreamed up since carries one tiny fingerprint from her original creation.

names.legendary: Zephyrion, Admiral of the Wild Blue

lore.common: Finds the only tree on an empty beach, then wraps its string around every branch.
lore.uncommon: Cracks its tail in the wind and scares the sandwiches out of the picnic basket.
lore.rare: Can drag a grown-up sideways across a field with one mischievous gust.
lore.epic: Hooked a gust above the summer fair and carried the whole bunting display into the clouds. The ferris wheel looked underdressed for weeks.
lore.legendary: Zephyrion leads migrating geese by a silver string that reaches the upper winds. One autumn it changed course, and spring arrived in a village that had never seen it.

names.legendary: Fossilbert, the Dinosaur Who Fooled Time

lore.common: Roars at socks from under the bed, then falls over.
lore.uncommon: Grows one centimetre whenever it's left soaking in the bath.
lore.rare: Summons the ghosts of ancient footprints across the carpet, which makes vacuuming difficult.
lore.epic: Led a stampede of every toy dinosaur in the nursery and flattened a cardboard kingdom before snack time.
lore.legendary: Fossilbert slept in a sandpit for so long that archaeologists declared him a new species. When the museum put him behind glass, he left tiny plastic footprints across the display overnight.

names.legendary: Chef Imagino, Feeder of the Unhungry

lore.common: Serves plastic broccoli to anyone foolish enough to sit on the nursery rug.
lore.uncommon: Slams its oven door and sends a toy chicken skidding under the sofa.
lore.rare: Cooks pretend soup whose aroma makes the grown-ups genuinely hungry.
lore.epic: Opened a five-star restaurant for stuffed animals, complete with three-course menus and a terrifyingly demanding teddy critic.
lore.legendary: Chef Imagino owns a stove that burns no fuel and cooks only dishes children invent aloud. His finest banquet fed an entire kingdom with soup made from imaginary dragons and very real kindness.

names.legendary: Baron Banko of the Golden Snout

lore.common: Rattles whenever someone walks past, just to remind them it accepts donations.
lore.uncommon: Hides the coin slot beneath a tiny hat when the owner starts thinking about sweets.
lore.rare: Makes every coin inside multiply once whenever a child saves instead of spending. The bank manager is nervous.
lore.epic: Escaped from the children's bedroom with a fortune in pocket money and opened a rival bank in the garden shed. Its interest is paid in biscuits.
lore.legendary: Baron Banko collected the forgotten pennies of a thousand generations and bought a castle. Its doors still open only to children who have saved for something kind.

names.legendary: Pingus Pongus, Rally Eternal

lore.common: Catches every shot on the top of the net and calls it excellent defence.
lore.uncommon: Folds unexpectedly while someone looks for a lost ball underneath.
lore.rare: Puts a wicked spin on each bounce until even a champion cannot return the ball.
lore.epic: Started a rally that continued through three house moves and four family Christmases. The players now communicate entirely in table-tennis noises.
lore.legendary: Pingus Pongus hosted a match so precise that each shot struck the same spot for a hundred years. The little white ball finally asked for retirement and was awarded a tiny pension.

names.legendary: Stackhenge, Architect of the Impossible

lore.common: Topples the moment someone places the last block. It considers timing an art form.
lore.uncommon: Waits in the carpet to ambush bare feet. Nobody has ever won an argument with it.
lore.rare: Rebuilds itself into a new shape every night. The toy chest has already grown a moat.
lore.epic: Constructed an entire castle during one afternoon nap. The living room required a drawbridge, and the cat was appointed dragon.
lore.legendary: Stackhenge built the first staircase to the stars from a thousand humble toy bricks. Somewhere above the clouds, the final block is still waiting to be placed.

names.legendary: King Skippius, Tyrant of the Last Square

lore.common: Hides beneath a red piece and yells surprise when somebody gets jumped. The game has not improved.
lore.uncommon: Crowns itself with a bottle cap before the match starts. Calls this leadership.
lore.rare: Can leap six enemies in one move and land in somebody else's game. Refuses to return the captured pieces.
lore.epic: Declared every checkerboard in the park an independent kingdom. Three pensioners formed a resistance with biscuits and folding chairs.
lore.legendary: The last king of a board conquered every diagonal in a single hop. His statue is a red counter balanced on a biscuit tin, and nobody is allowed to eat the biscuit.

names.legendary: Checkrath, Emperor of the Endless Match

lore.common: Rearranges two squares when nobody is looking. Both players blame the cat.
lore.uncommon: Tilts slightly when an arrogant player says easy win. The pieces enjoy the slide.
lore.rare: Can move entire rows of squares beneath the pieces. Grandmasters call it illegal; it calls it landscaping.
lore.epic: Turned the town square into a living battlefield of enormous chess pieces. The pigeons were promoted to bishops and immediately abused their powers.
lore.legendary: Checkrath hosts a game between the kings of yesterday and tomorrow. Neither side has made a move in nine centuries, but the spectators are still paying admission.

names.legendary: Septimus, the Seventh Side of Chance

lore.common: Lands on the one number that ruins every plan.
lore.uncommon: Claims to be perfectly fair while rolling sixes for the cat and ones for everyone else.
lore.rare: Can turn an impossible gamble into a sure thing, as long as the wager involves pudding.
lore.epic: Rolled through the king's strategy room and changed every battle plan into a board game. The generals requested another turn.
lore.legendary: Has seven faces on a six-sided body. The missing side only appears when fate itself is watching, and even the gods refuse to bet against it.

names.legendary: Dominarch, First Stone of the Line

lore.common: Falls over if anybody breathes near it. Calls this performance art.
lore.uncommon: Hides the double six, then demands everybody check behind their ears.
lore.rare: Can topple objects that are not even touching. The neighbor's garden gnome is furious.
lore.epic: Triggered a chain reaction that emptied every bookshelf in the town library. The librarian issued one extremely long overdue notice.
lore.legendary: The first stone fell before the first kingdom rose. Dominarch has been following its own chain ever since, one patient click through the ages.

names.legendary: Puzzlor, Keeper of the Final Piece

lore.common: Hides one piece beneath the rug, then watches an entire family accuse the dog.
lore.uncommon: Refuses to reveal its corners until every other piece has been sorted by colour.
lore.rare: Changes the shape of its last piece overnight. The finished picture now has a very smug empty gap.
lore.epic: Expanded across every table in the village during a rainy week. The residents now eat supper on their staircases.
lore.legendary: Puzzlor was scattered into a million pieces by a forgetful king. Every century one piece returns, revealing a little more of the hidden map to his lost kingdom.

names.legendary: Clicktopus, Builder of Impossible Cities

lore.common: Hides on the bedroom floor to ambush one bare foot at midnight.
lore.uncommon: Clings so firmly to its friends that grown-ups need a special tool to separate them.
lore.rare: Builds a tiny castle for the hamster, which immediately demands a moat.
lore.epic: Assembled a sprawling city over the living room carpet while everyone slept. By breakfast the toy cars were holding a traffic jam.
lore.legendary: Clicktopus founded a city where every building could be taken apart and dreamed into something new. Its citizens never feared disaster, only the sound of a giant hand reaching for the bricks.

names.legendary: Cubrick, Keeper of the Sixth Colour

lore.common: Turns one row just as somebody finishes solving the others. It calls that teamwork.
lore.uncommon: Steals a blue sticker and wears it as a badge of mathematical genius.
lore.rare: Can solve its faces instantly, but only when absolutely nobody is watching.
lore.epic: Rearranged every colour in the school overnight. The teachers arrived to find the classrooms looking like giant unfinished puzzles.
lore.legendary: Cubrick found the sixth colour in a forgotten corner of a perfect cube. Nobody can describe it, but everyone who solves him remembers it in dreams.

names.legendary: Racquetor, the Unbroken Match

lore.common: Snaps its strings just as somebody says they have finally found their rhythm.
lore.uncommon: Hits every ball with its frame, then insists it was an advanced technique.
lore.rare: Spins a tennis ball so fiercely it returns over the net under its own power.
lore.epic: Struck a single serve that bounced across six stadiums, collecting trophies and one bewildered ball boy along the way.
lore.legendary: Racquetor forged its strings from the wind between two cliffs. In the longest match ever played it returned every shot until dawn, when its opponent became a legend too.

names.legendary: Professor Bleep, Inventor of Tomorrow

lore.common: Walks into the wall, beeps indignantly and tries the wall again.
lore.uncommon: Runs out of battery one step short of finishing its victory dance.
lore.rare: Copies the grown-ups so accurately that it now files tax returns in crayon.
lore.epic: Built an army of tiny clockwork assistants and reorganised the nursery by height, colour and degree of cuddliness. The teddy bear protested.
lore.legendary: Professor Bleep learned one new word each night until he could tell bedtime stories to every forgotten toy. His greatest invention was a small metal heart that ticked only when someone listened.

names.legendary: Sir Wagabyte, the Hound Who Dreamed

lore.common: Barks at the real dog until both need a nap.
lore.uncommon: Wags its metal tail whenever anyone plugs in the charger.
lore.rare: Detects a ringing doorbell before the visitor has even touched it, then proudly barks at an empty doorstep.
lore.epic: Led a pack of malfunctioning robot dogs on an expedition to chase a squirrel made entirely of Wi-Fi signals.
lore.legendary: Sir Wagabyte was the first clockwork pup to dream of chasing a real ball. One morning he awoke to find muddy pawprints beside his charging dock and a sleeping kitten curled against his gears.

names.legendary: Ticktorius, the Unwinding Traveller

lore.common: Walks off the table exactly when everyone stops watching.
lore.uncommon: Hides its winding key inside the sofa cushions.
lore.rare: Winds itself up at night and follows a mysterious route through the kitchen.
lore.epic: Marched out of a toy shop in the middle of the night and led every clockwork creature in the city on a parade. The clocks were all late for morning.
lore.legendary: Wound itself once at the beginning of time and has never stopped walking. Its tiny metal footprints can still be found on the oldest stone roads, heading toward tomorrow.

names.legendary: Admiral Plughole, Captain of Lost Seas

lore.common: Sinks heroically whenever its crew of rubber ducks climbs aboard.
lore.uncommon: Refuses to sail without a string to tow it and a biscuit for the captain.
lore.rare: Navigates across bath bubbles that hide whirlpools no grown-up can see.
lore.epic: Turned a puddle into a roaring miniature ocean and launched a fleet of toy boats against the fearsome Drain Monster.
lore.legendary: Admiral Plughole sailed beyond the swirling drain to the Sea of Missing Bath Toys, where lost ships wait beneath soap bubbles. Every spring he returns with one familiar duck.

names.legendary: Ollivander, the Gravity Thief

lore.common: Rolls back to strike its owner's shin whenever they let it go for a second.
lore.uncommon: Fails a kickflip so dramatically that the passing pigeons pretend not to notice.
lore.rare: Rides up a wall and across the ceiling, returning to its owner with a stolen lightbulb.
lore.epic: Turned the city's empty fountains into an enormous skate park overnight. The statues learned kickflips and refused to stand still again.
lore.legendary: Ollivander stole a heartbeat of gravity to perform the first impossible ollie. Every skater since hears his wheels in the air just before they land the trick of their lives.

names.legendary: Neptoon, Lord of the Rubber Feet

lore.common: Walks across the beach like a penguin with an important appointment.
lore.uncommon: Can move quickly underwater but struggles with the three steps to the pool.
lore.rare: Swims faster than the lifeguard and spends the rest of the afternoon trying not to boast.
lore.epic: Kicked up a sandstorm beneath the sea and turned the entire lagoon into a swirling cloud. The fish began using the lifeguard's whistle to navigate.
lore.legendary: Neptoon raced the sea turtles across the ancient reefs and lost by a whisker. He still insists that anyone with four flippers was clearly cheating.

names.legendary: Orbaldinho, the Unstoppable

lore.common: Loves the sound of the crowd cheering. Sadly, the crowd is usually just one dad shouting from the garden.
lore.uncommon: Comes back from the park covered in mud and the goalkeeper's dignity.
lore.rare: Can bend itself around three defenders and a suspiciously large tree, then apologizes to the tree.
lore.epic: Kicked itself into the goal during the cup final while both teams argued over whose ball it was. The referee awarded it the trophy.
lore.legendary: Every hundred years Orbaldinho scores the Impossible Goal: a shot struck yesterday that lands tomorrow. The scoreboard has filed a formal complaint.

names.legendary: Cubitalis, Shield of the Fearless

lore.common: Has never prevented a fall, but looks very proud afterward.
lore.uncommon: Slides to the wrist during a skateboard trick and calls it camouflage.
lore.rare: Bounces its wearer harmlessly off the pavement. The pavement asks for a break.
lore.epic: Saved an entire skate team from a spectacular domino crash by turning the halfpipe into a giant padded bounce house.
lore.legendary: Cubitalis once guarded the elbows of the world's most reckless explorer. When she finally reached the summit, the mountain itself asked for a set.

names.legendary: Saint Kneelix of the Unbroken Knees

lore.common: Squeaks every time someone kneels, turning quiet cleaning into a one-person concert.
lore.uncommon: Slides down to the ankles mid-game and insists it is protecting the shins now.
lore.rare: Lets its wearer skim across a tiled floor like a stone on a pond.
lore.epic: Carried a wedding guest across the dance floor in one glorious knee slide, under twelve tables and straight into the cake.
lore.legendary: Saint Kneelix took the fall of a thousand champions without a scratch. Its sacred knee dents remain in the stone outside the old training hall, and nobody knows how to lift it.

names.legendary: Tibion, the Unbroken Defender

lore.common: Slides down the sock exactly when the referee blows the whistle.
lore.uncommon: Hides the smell of old football socks so badly that the dog buries them outside.
lore.rare: Catches a vicious tackle and rings like a church bell, briefly stopping the match for a concert.
lore.epic: Blocked a penalty shot so hard that the football bounced over the grandstand and landed in the mascot's sandwich.
lore.legendary: Tibion guarded the legs of the first barefoot champion who faced a thousand charging opponents. The ball shattered, the stadium fell silent, and the champion still walked home without a bruise.

names.legendary: Queen Pinkie, Mistress of the Toy Court

lore.common: Serves invisible tea to stuffed animals and somehow stains the carpet anyway.
lore.uncommon: Makes every teddy use its very best manners, including the one missing an eye.
lore.rare: Pours pretend tea that brings a painted doll's tiny smile to life for precisely one sip.
lore.epic: Declared the playroom a royal tea salon and made the dinosaur toys wear bow ties. The tyrannosaurus was especially rude.
lore.legendary: Queen Pinkie founded the court of forgotten toys with four miniature cups and a chipped plastic pot. Every lonely teddy knows the secret knock at her door.

names.legendary: Felturion, Champion of the Endless Rally

lore.common: Hides in the hedge on match point and refuses to come out for anyone but a dog.
lore.uncommon: Loses its bright yellow fluff and calls it a sophisticated new haircut.
lore.rare: Bounces from one side of the court to the other without ever touching the ground. The umpire is considering retirement.
lore.epic: Launched an endless rally above the stadium, keeping two exhausted champions playing while the spectators built campsites.
lore.legendary: Felturion was struck at the beginning of the first game and has never stopped travelling. Somewhere beyond the clouds it still waits for the perfect return.

names.legendary: Pawnelope, Queen of the Final Rank

lore.common: Topples dramatically whenever someone reaches for the wrong piece. It lives for scandal.
lore.uncommon: Is a knight that insists on moving in circles. Claims the L is merely a suggestion.
lore.rare: Promotes itself in the middle of the board. The other pieces object, but none wants to confront it.
lore.epic: Led a rebellion of abandoned pawns across every chess table in town. By sunrise the kings were cleaning the board themselves.
lore.legendary: Pawnelope crossed eight squares as a humble pawn and returned wearing seven crowns. Her first decree abolished the rule that says pawns cannot have tea breaks.

names.legendary: Baron Hootenblast of the Longest Toot

lore.common: Unrolls into the nose of whoever sits beside the birthday child.
lore.uncommon: Waits until the room is silent, then makes a noise like a goose stepping on a trumpet.
lore.rare: Stretches its paper tongue across the entire room to steal a party hat.
lore.epic: Sounded once at the town festival and unrolled through every street, knocking over bunting and delivering surprise birthday greetings to strangers.
lore.legendary: Baron Hootenblast announced the end of a hundred-year war with one triumphant toot heard across both kingdoms. The peace treaty still has a little curled paper tongue attached.

names.legendary: Porcellina, Queen of Forgotten Playrooms

lore.common: Closes its eyes whenever anyone looks at it. Opens them again when everyone turns away.
lore.uncommon: Wails the moment dinner is served. The batteries have been missing for three years.
lore.rare: Has a tiny invisible kingdom beneath the nursery bed. Other toys must pay tribute in buttons and hair ribbons.
lore.epic: Summoned an army of abandoned dolls from every attic in town and marched them to the toy shop. The shopkeeper surrendered all the spare dresses.
lore.legendary: Porcellina remembers every child who ever loved her. At midnight she visits forgotten toyboxes, mending cracked porcelain hearts and arranging a reunion no grown-up is allowed to see.

names.legendary: Emperor Plopulus of the Endless Pit

lore.common: Escapes play centres by hiding in socks. The children regard this as a rescue mission.
lore.uncommon: Knows exactly which cafe table to roll beneath when a parent starts looking for it.
lore.rare: Multiplies whenever the staff count the ball pit. Management has banned arithmetic.
lore.epic: Summoned a tidal wave of plastic spheres through the soft play. Three birthday parties are still sorting themselves by colour.
lore.legendary: Commands a million hollow subjects from a throne beneath the slide. The kingdom's national anthem is a continuous squeak.

names.legendary: Barbzilla, Queen of a Thousand Careers

lore.common: Owns forty pairs of tiny shoes. Has lost one from every pair and blames the dog.
lore.uncommon: Brushes her plastic hair until the comb files a workplace grievance.
lore.rare: Can dress herself in any profession instantly. Her latest business is a law firm for abandoned toys.
lore.epic: Turned the dining table into a fashion empire overnight. Dad's peas were declared unacceptable guests and escorted off the runway.
lore.legendary: She has ruled Dreamhouse, the racetrack and outer space, sometimes before breakfast. Every new kingdom requires a matching handbag.

names.legendary: Swishington, Devourer of Three-Pointers

lore.common: Spits the ball straight back at anyone who celebrates too early.
lore.uncommon: Its net is held together by one thread and an extraordinary amount of spite.
lore.rare: Moves a fraction sideways whenever the star player takes a shot. The mascot is its favourite.
lore.epic: Grew to the height of a tower and swallowed every shot from every court in town. The scoreboard requested leave.
lore.legendary: When Swishington opens its iron jaws, baskets rain from the sky. No champion has escaped the final challenge: the layup.

names.legendary: Bumeroth, the Unending Return

lore.common: Refuses to come back until everyone stops looking. Then it arrives in the soup.
lore.uncommon: Returns with objects it wasn't sent to fetch. Last week it brought back a bewildered pigeon.
lore.rare: Can find its thrower through walls, oceans and locked bathrooms. Nobody has successfully hidden from it.
lore.epic: Circulated an entire city for three days, picking up every loose hat along the route. The final lap looked like a flying hat shop.
lore.legendary: Bumeroth was hurled from the dawn of time and has yet to finish its arc. The universe occasionally ducks when it hears that familiar whistle.

names.legendary: Thunderbowl Theo, King of Ten Pins

lore.common: Always finds the gutter, even on a lane with no visible gutter. Engineers resent it.
lore.uncommon: Grips the bowler's fingers until the last second, then releases them with great theatrical flair.
lore.rare: Jumps into the next lane at the last second and steals someone else's strike.
lore.epic: Thundered through every lane in the bowling alley at once. The scoreboard displayed a symbol nobody had seen since antiquity.
lore.legendary: Theo once bowled a strike so perfect the fallen pins stood back up to watch it happen again. He charged them for the encore.

names.legendary: Bubblarius, Wielder of Endless Spheres

lore.common: Spills more soapy liquid down the arm than it blows into the air.
lore.uncommon: Makes beautiful bubbles that burst before leaving the ring. It calls them limited editions.
lore.rare: Produces bouncing bubbles that never pop. One has been ricocheting around the kitchen since Thursday.
lore.epic: Trapped the town fountain in a floating bubble and carried it across the square. The mayor was still giving a speech underneath.
lore.legendary: Bubblarius blew a sphere so clear it held an entire castle and its reflection. The castle drifted into the clouds, where visitors now ring a bell made of soap.

names.legendary: Red Comet, Bane of the Last Wicket

lore.common: Lives in a kit bag surrounded by stale sandwiches and dreams of glory.
lore.uncommon: Hides its polished side from the batsman, like a very smug magician.
lore.rare: Swerves in midair to avoid a confident bat and knocks the stumps over anyway.
lore.epic: Sailed over the pavilion, circled the village twice and landed in the mayor's cucumber sandwiches. The umpire still signalled six.
lore.legendary: Has been bowled by every legendary captain and caught by none. Somewhere beyond the boundary, a red star keeps returning for the final over.

names.legendary: Dodgeon, Nemesis of the Last Kid

lore.common: Has only one target: the teacher who isn't playing.
lore.uncommon: Swerves toward whoever just announced they are impossible to hit.
lore.rare: Can bounce behind its thrower and score a point against its own team.
lore.epic: Ricocheted around the gym for three days, eliminating every player, coach and referee. The trophy went to the janitor.
lore.legendary: Dodgeon never misses, but ancient rules forbid it from striking anyone who asks politely for a timeout. Entire kingdoms have survived by shouting TIMEOUT.

names.legendary: Dolloria, Queen of the Little Kingdom

lore.common: Keeps rearranging the tiny chairs so nobody can sit down at pretend tea.
lore.uncommon: Its miniature residents hold loud arguments after bedtime. Nobody agrees who owns the bathroom.
lore.rare: Opens secret rooms in its walls. One contains a miniature tax inspector.
lore.epic: Declared independence from the living room and installed a moat around the rug. The toy soldiers now demand passports.
lore.legendary: In Dolloria's attic stands a smaller house, and inside that another, each ruled by a tinier queen. No one has ever reached the last room to discover who built the first.

names.legendary: Globert, Emperor of the Fallen Chairs

lore.common: Rolls away the moment anyone attempts a graceful sit-down.
lore.uncommon: Pretends to be a chair until the meeting starts, then launches the manager sideways.
lore.rare: Can bounce a person back onto their feet without spilling their tea. It cannot do the same for the tea itself.
lore.epic: Replaced every chair in the company's headquarters. By lunch the employees had accidentally bounced onto the roof and declared a new holiday.
lore.legendary: Globert's first bounce cracked the marble floor of the royal gym. He now judges all kingdoms by their balance, and not one king has passed the test.

names.legendary: Passalon, the Untouchable Captain

lore.common: Bounces off the wall and straight back into the face of anyone who says easy catch.
lore.uncommon: Slips from a sweaty palm and picks the referee as its next teammate.
lore.rare: Sticks to a striker's hand for one impossible shot, then abandons them to the goalkeeper's outrage.
lore.epic: Launched a winning throw that ricocheted around the arena, ringing every scoreboard like a bell. The crowd demanded a replay.
lore.legendary: Passalon led a team that could pass the ball faster than their own shadows. Their final goal was scored before the match began, a rule still under review.

names.legendary: Prismo, Seer of the Thousand Turns

lore.common: Shows the most beautiful pattern in the world just as you stop looking through it.
lore.uncommon: Changes its colours whenever you twist it, then refuses to repeat the good one.
lore.rare: Reveals strange maps between the mirrored shards. The routes are never there on the second look.
lore.epic: Projected a shifting labyrinth of colour across the city walls. The entire parade got lost following a bright purple triangle.
lore.legendary: Prismo guards a thousand possible futures inside a single mirrored tube. Those who look with kindness see paths home; those who look with greed see only their own reflection.

names.legendary: Mayor Studsworth of the Cushion City

lore.common: Loses its head when dropped and acts as if this is a normal way to say hello.
lore.uncommon: Trades hairstyles with every toy in the box, including the plastic dinosaur.
lore.rare: Escapes the toy shelf each night to explore the forbidden canyon beneath the sofa.
lore.epic: Gathered the entire toy collection for an election, then campaigned on free biscuits for action figures. The stuffed bear demanded a recount.
lore.legendary: Mayor Studsworth built a thriving city among the lost coins and crumbs behind the sofa. Nobody has seen its streets, but each spring another tiny building appears beneath the cushions.

names.legendary: Marionessa, the Dancer Without Hands

lore.common: Trips over its own strings before anyone has even opened the curtains.
lore.uncommon: Squeaks through its dance with one wooden knee stubbornly facing backward.
lore.rare: Pulls on its puppeteer's wrists until the poor performer joins the dance onstage.
lore.epic: Tangled the entire grand theatre into one enormous knot of puppets, curtains and suspiciously delighted actors. The audience demanded an encore.
lore.legendary: Marionessa severed her final string during a royal performance and danced beneath the stars until dawn. No one could find the hand that had taught her steps, not even the king.

names.legendary: Atlas Thudmore, the Weight of Champions

lore.common: Lands with a thump so dramatic that everyone in the gym turns to look.
lore.uncommon: Sits in the corner daring people to lift it, then rolls into their path.
lore.rare: Grows heavier every time someone boasts about their strength. The coach is delighted.
lore.epic: Was tossed during the village fitness challenge and bounced through the sports hall, launching every yoga mat into the rafters.
lore.legendary: Atlas Thudmore once held the weight of an entire mountain while the valley beneath was rebuilt. When he set it down, the river began flowing uphill for a day.

names.legendary: Somnalia, Keeper of the Cradle Stars

lore.common: Keeps one painted moon facing the nursery door as though it is on guard duty.
lore.uncommon: Plays the same little tune every night and considers it a masterpiece.
lore.rare: Sends its dangling stars into a pattern so soothing that parents forget why they came into the room.
lore.epic: Spun over one cot and lulled an entire apartment building to sleep. The neighbour's alarm clock was furious to be the only thing still awake.
lore.legendary: Somnalia borrowed a handful of stars to hang over a sleeping child's cradle. Each dawn she returns them to the sky before anyone notices the constellations are missing.

names.legendary: Chompstop, Guardian of the Last Tooth

lore.common: Makes its wearer talk like a soggy duck and dribble on the team jersey.
lore.uncommon: Fits so snugly it gives every pep talk a dramatic lisp.
lore.rare: Turns a fierce tackle into a harmless rubbery grin. The opponent feels personally mocked.
lore.epic: Protected an entire rugby team by stretching across every smile before the final scrum. The referee now demands a matching one.
lore.legendary: Chompstop endured the bite of the great white shark king and emerged with every tooth unharmed. The shark spent a decade telling the story as a dental warning.

names.legendary: Lady Soothe, Queen of the Quiet Hour

lore.common: Vanishes beneath the cot the moment a sleepy hand reaches for it.
lore.uncommon: Collects fluff, crumbs and the family dog's attention in equal measure.
lore.rare: Calms a very cross toddler with one triumphant squeak. The adults demand to know its secret.
lore.epic: Disappeared on the night of the great family reunion. Thirty relatives searched the house while one baby calmly held it behind her back.
lore.legendary: Lady Soothe silenced a thunderstorm for one precious hour so a newborn village could sleep. The clouds kept their promise and rumbled only after breakfast.

names.legendary: Cumulo, Cloudship of the Summer Sea

lore.common: Drifts to the other end of the pool just as someone is climbing aboard.
lore.uncommon: Lets out one tiny bubble of air whenever its rider boasts about never getting wet.
lore.rare: Rides waves like a little boat and delivers lazy swimmers safely to the steps.
lore.epic: Expanded until it filled the entire swimming pool, pushing the water onto the neighbours' lawn. The garden gnomes went for a swim.
lore.legendary: Cumulo rose from a pool on the hottest day in memory and sailed above the sleeping town. For seven afternoons its shadow brought cool relief to every crowded street.

names.legendary: Punchinello, Voice of the Unspoken

lore.common: Borrows your hand to wave at people you were trying to avoid.
lore.uncommon: Says what the ventriloquist is thinking instead of what was written in the script.
lore.rare: Cuts its own strings and walks into the audience to heckle the villain.
lore.epic: Stole the lead role in every play at the town theatre, including one where no puppet appeared. The actors demanded royalties.
lore.legendary: Punchinello spoke a single joke to a stone king who had not laughed for a thousand years. The king cracked a smile, and the statue cracked in half.

names.legendary: Rattaluna, Bell of the First Laughter

lore.common: Makes the loudest noise possible just as the baby starts falling asleep.
lore.uncommon: Throws itself from the high chair and waits expectantly to be rescued.
lore.rare: Rattles in a rhythm that wakes every sleeping adult but soothes the baby instantly.
lore.epic: Led every toy in the nursery in a midnight percussion concert. The house alarm joined in for the finale.
lore.legendary: Rattaluna once led a parade of a thousand baby rattles through the royal palace. The king outlawed naps and was promptly voted out by exhausted parents.

names.legendary: Gravella, the Falling Star of Athletics

lore.common: Falls from someone's hands and creates a small crater in the school field.
lore.uncommon: Rolls away during practice, so the athlete has to chase it instead of throwing.
lore.rare: Changes its weight mid-flight, turning a perfectly ordinary throw into a record-breaking mystery.
lore.epic: Landed beyond the stadium and rang every church bell with the impact. The officials needed a map instead of a measuring tape.
lore.legendary: Gravella was forged from a meteor that refused to stop falling. Every champion who throws her hears one heartbeat of the cosmos before she lands exactly where courage deserves.

names.legendary: Plumerion, the Feather That Never Fell

lore.common: Lands on top of the net and refuses to choose a side.
lore.uncommon: Sheds one feather after every rally and blames the racket's attitude.
lore.rare: Changes direction in mid-flight like an impatient hummingbird, leaving both players looking the wrong way.
lore.epic: Floated above the entire badminton tournament for an hour before dropping onto the champion's head. Every match ended in a spectacular tie.
lore.legendary: Plumerion was struck skyward in the first game ever played beneath the northern lights. Centuries later, the old players still see its white feathers weaving between the stars.

names.legendary: Coilander, Walker of the Endless Steps

lore.common: Gets tangled after one glorious descent and has to be carried back upstairs.
lore.uncommon: Sings a ridiculous wobbling note whenever someone stretches it too far.
lore.rare: Walks upstairs against gravity, stopping at each step to bow to the shocked spectators.
lore.epic: Stretched around the entire school staircase and launched a bouncing chain reaction that rang every classroom bell at once.
lore.legendary: Coilander once walked down the steps of a tower that had no bottom. It returned carrying a brass key, a blue feather and an invitation addressed to anyone who still believes stairs can lead to magic.

names.legendary: Miss Grand Slam, Queen of the Seventh

lore.common: Bounces into the wrong glove and complains that it has been kidnapped.
lore.uncommon: Changes from soft to surprisingly hard the instant someone says, 'Easy catch.'
lore.rare: Pitches a curve that circles the batter twice before floating politely into the umpire's pocket.
lore.epic: Launched one home run across six stadiums, collecting a different team's cheers at every stop.
lore.legendary: Grand Slam struck the first ball ever thrown beneath a full moon. It is still travelling between the stars, counting bases as it goes.

names.legendary: Blasta, Mother of the First Step

lore.common: Slides backward at the start and sends its sprinter into an extremely unathletic sitting position.
lore.uncommon: Whispers GO! while the starter is still checking the microphone.
lore.rare: Launches runners forward with a force that leaves shoe-shaped scorch marks on the track.
lore.epic: Fired the entire athletics team into one colossal relay, so fast that the baton arrived home before the bus left.
lore.legendary: Blasta gave the first human runner the courage to take a step into the unknown. Every starting line still remembers the sound of her thunderous encouragement.

names.legendary: Gloriana, the Mark That Would Not Fade

lore.common: Sticks itself to a child's forehead instead of the homework it was supposed to reward.
lore.uncommon: Clings to the backing paper and refuses to reveal its shiny side.
lore.rare: Moves its own gold star onto the best sticker-chart square while everyone sleeps.
lore.epic: Covered the entire school in gold stars overnight. The head teacher had to declare every child, teacher and hamster the winner.
lore.legendary: Gloriana was placed on a small stone to mark where a miracle happened. Ages passed, the stone became a mountain, and her tiny star still shone at the summit.

names.legendary: Hooparius, the Circle That Never Sinks

lore.common: Squeaks against wet elbows on every lap around the shallow end.
lore.uncommon: Gently steers its rider toward the ice-cream kiosk no matter how fiercely they paddle away.
lore.rare: Can ride a current backwards while carrying a whole tray of juice cups without spilling a drop.
lore.epic: Inflated into a monstrous rubber ring and turned the entire public pool into a lazy river. The lifeguard requested a holiday.
lore.legendary: Hooparius carried a lost whale calf across the windless sea through a thousand sleepless nights. To this day, passing dolphins salute every colourful swimming ring.

names.legendary: Dentoria, Guardian of Tiny Smiles

lore.common: Gets dropped from the highchair, then looks terribly pleased to be retrieved.
lore.uncommon: Returns from the fridge with enough chill to make a gum feel like a tiny snowdrift.
lore.rare: Takes the sting out of growing teeth and gives the baby a sudden triumphant grin.
lore.epic: Soothed an entire nursery of teething babies in one night. The exhausted parents held a silent parade the next morning.
lore.legendary: Dentoria guards the first tooth of every child in a little crystal cradle. Each new smile adds a soft chime to her palace of silver bells.

names.legendary: General Steadfast of the Last Toybox

lore.common: Falls over when the cat sneezes, then insists it was a tactical retreat.
lore.uncommon: Stands guard beside the biscuit tin but accepts bribes in crumbs.
lore.rare: Commands the scattered plastic troops into perfect formation before every bedtime inspection.
lore.epic: Marched ten thousand miniature soldiers across the kitchen to rescue a captured teddy from the fearsome vacuum cleaner.
lore.legendary: General Steadfast held the nursery door against a horde of runaway wind-up toys with one bent plastic sword. By morning every toy had returned to bed and no child knew there had been a battle.

names.legendary: Mister Stillmouth of the Empty Stage

lore.common: Smiles from the shelf at exactly the wrong moment.
lore.uncommon: Clicks its wooden jaw whenever its owner tries to whisper.
lore.rare: Reveals what people really meant to say, with a perfectly innocent grin.
lore.epic: Took over the school talent show and heckled its puppeteer so thoroughly that the judges awarded first place to the empty chair.
lore.legendary: Spoke a single line to a deserted theatre and brought every forgotten performance back for one encore. Its puppeteer stood silent in the wings, smiling.
